Markets.title: Telecom stocks under fire, sink up to 13% as Elon Musk’s Starlink buys spectrum from Grain Management
Markets.summary: SpaceX's acquisition of spectrum licenses from Grain Management has triggered fears of major disruption in the US telecom industry. Consequently, shares of major carriers including Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile dropped by as much as 13 percent.

Markets.title: FII ownership hits 17-year low, but foreign holdings in Indian equities rise 3.6 times to $783 billion: Report
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investor ownership in Indian equities dropped to a 17-year low of 15.1% due to surging domestic participation. However, the total value of these foreign holdings increased significantly to $783 billion.

Markets.title: US Market: Four warning signs that bond selling could intensify
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields have reached two-decade highs due to Middle East conflict risks and fiscal concerns. Indicators such as rising options hedging and record corporate borrowing suggest the bond selloff could worsen before attracting new buyers.

Markets.title: Global Market: Goldman Sachs raises December Brent oil price forecast to $90 on supply risks
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs raised its December 2026 Brent crude price forecast to $90 per barrel due to potential supply risks in the Middle East. The firm warned that severe Gulf production cuts could push prices as high as $125 per barrel.

Markets.title: Cheap Venezuelan crude could add up to Rs 12,600 crore to RIL’s EBITDA. What investors should know
Markets.summary: Reliance Industries could increase its annualised EBITDA by up to Rs 12,600 crore if it gains renewed access to discounted Venezuelan crude for its Jamnagar complex. However, the actual financial impact will depend on factors such as regulatory uncertainty, crude discount levels, and refinery utilisation.

Markets.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields ease as Russia-Ukraine energy truce lifts sentiment
Markets.summary: Eurozone government bond yields declined and bond spreads narrowed following a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire announcement and lower energy prices. Despite this positive sentiment, investors continued to price in higher European Central Bank rates amid ongoing inflation and geopolitical concerns.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky backs Trump's 'energy ceasefire' but says Russia continues to hit power plants
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky supports Donald Trump's proposed "energy ceasefire" if Russia agrees to it. However, Zelensky reports that Russian forces continue to strike Ukraine's power plants.

Geo-Political.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: An investigation by the BBC revealed that Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich used backdated and falsified documents to evade taxes on his wealth. The fraudulent paperwork also successfully hid his luxury yachts and mansions from official financial accounts.

Geo-Political.title: Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia
Geo-Political.summary: Lawmakers from both the Republican and Democratic parties are criticizing Donald Trump's plans to import diesel fuel from Russia. The deal was announced just weeks before the United States midterm elections.

Geo-Political.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
Geo-Political.summary: An Iran-backed Houthi strike on the Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia killed one person and injured 11 others. This attack marked the second time the airport was hit by the Yemeni group over the weekend.

Geo-Political.title: American ranchers wrestle with soaring costs - and their loyalty to Trump
Geo-Political.summary: American farmers in pro-Trump states are facing surging operating costs ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. These financial pressures are straining the loyalty of some ranchers who previously supported the president.

Geo-Political.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish police arrested a man suspected of plotting an assassination against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted on credible intelligence indicating potential attacks targeting both Tusk and his defense minister.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI-driven traffic compared to traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI Studio platform focused on content generation. The tool allows users to create, share, and monetize their artificial intelligence content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace productivity. These widely used market solutions drive innovation and efficiency across various industry applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audiences. However, with numerous options currently available on the market, choosing the right tool can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers common questions.

Data & Insights.title: How the oil crisis is morphing into a shipping crisis, in 5 charts
Data & Insights.summary: The US-Iran war has caused shipping costs to surge by up to 10 times for oil, 73% for finished goods, and 49% for commodities. Consequently, shipowners are earning higher profit margins and investing in new capacity while facing increased risks.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Inflation pressures, IMF’s growth forecasts, crude output
Data & Insights.summary: Upcoming economic events include reports on inflation pressures and crude oil output. Additionally, the International Monetary Fund will release its latest global growth forecasts.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: An economic think tank has urged the government to withdraw a proposed 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The organization warned that the fee would increase consumer prices, squeeze small businesses, and weaken overall demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital warns that persistent inflation could force the RBI to raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points in the current cycle. While gradual rate increases are the most likely outcome, a larger hike cannot be ruled out as early as December 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is directly supplying dollars to three state-run oil companies and tightening currency derivative rules to support the falling rupee. These measures aim to reduce foreign-exchange market demand and curb volatility as the currency trades near its record low.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: rate hikes, SIP flows, Airtel’s tariffs
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-driven charts and insights based on Mint's reporting from the past week. The topics covered include interest rate hikes, Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) flows, and Bharti Airtel's tariffs.

India.title: Delhi-NCR Sees Rain After Monsoon Withdrawal: 3 Weather Factors Explained
India.summary: Despite the recent monsoon withdrawal, the IMD forecasts isolated to scattered rainfall across Delhi, Haryana, and Chandigarh. This wet weather is expected to persist from October 11 through October 15.

India.title: Failed UPSC 6 Times, Clears Bihar, Haryana Services: Parikshit Madan's Preparation Journey Of 9 Years
India.summary: After failing the UPSC exams six times over nine years, Parikshit Madan successfully cleared the civil services exams in Bihar and Haryana. To achieve this success, he focused heavily on answer writing and practiced with previous years' question papers for the main exam.

India.title: "Gyanesh Kumar Unable To Sleep, Cops Unhappy Too": Rahul Gandhi's Big Charge
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi announced that the opposition will file a Supreme Court petition this evening against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Gandhi claimed that Kumar is unable to sleep and that police officers are also unhappy.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Transfers Rs 502 Crore Under RTE Scheme, 20,456 Private Schools To Benefit
India.summary: Madhya Pradesh has transferred Rs 502 crore in Right to Education fee reimbursements to private schools. The funds will benefit 20,456 schools that provide free education to economically weaker and disadvantaged students.

India.title: "Sex For Marks": BJP Protests Against Congress MP Charged Of Harassment At JNU
India.summary: Jawaharlal Nehru University fired Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam after finding him guilty of sexually harassing female students. The lawmaker has denied these charges, while the BJP has protested against him.

India.title: "Not Government Property": Temple Board Member On Tirumala Land Usage Order
India.summary: A BJP leader and Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) board member stated that temple land is not government property. He asserted that subleasing the property would violate the TTD Act of 1997 and applicable rules.

General.title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth, BBC finds
General.summary: A BBC investigation found that Deloitte helped falsify backdated documents to help Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich evade taxes on his wealth. The altered paperwork also removed his yachts and mansions from financial accounts.

General.title: Rejecting closer EU ties would be dereliction of duty, PM to say
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham will tell the Commons that rejecting closer ties with the European Union would be a dereliction of duty. He is expected to argue that a new EU deal can help improve economic growth and tackle illegal immigration.

General.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
General.summary: A Houthi missile strike on the Riyadh airport killed one person and injured 11 others. This attack marks the second time in two days that the Saudi capital has been targeted by the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.

General.title: Russell Brand arrives at court for start of rape trial
General.summary: Actor and comedian Russell Brand has arrived in court for the start of his trial. He denies charges of rape and sexual assault involving six women.

General.title: Reform pledges to suspend asylum system for up to five years and deport claimants
General.summary: Reform UK has pledged to suspend all asylum applications for up to five years and void existing ones. Under the proposed policy, all claimants would be marked for immediate deportation.

General.title: Watch moment orangutan family released back into the wild after Borneo fires
General.summary: An orangutan family was released back into the wild in Borneo after being rescued from intense wildfires in August and September. These critically endangered apes had their natural habitat destroyed by the fires before being saved.
